{{Quote|The keen of their pleading wails came to an end when I returned to my palace and bolted the door.|An extract from the Chronicle of Sorzus Syn, 6899 BBY|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
The '''palace''' of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sorzus Syn]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="Book of Sith" /> In [[6899 BBY]],<ref name="Exile Second Year">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' states that latter part of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle took place in the "Exile Year Two, Months 7-9". Per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' the first year took place in [[6900 BBY]], thus the second year would be [[6899 BBY]].</ref> Sorzus Syn returned to her palace after she found the evidence of [[Sith Empire expansion|Sith raids]] of other worlds. She mentioned the palace in her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|titular chronicle]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sorzus Syn's palace was first mentioned in the [[2012]] resource guide ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
